question: Where can I get a list of biogas and biomethane projects currently in permitting in the United States, with location, capacity, developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: No national list of biogas/RNG projects in permitting was found. Stage and date are documented only in local records: CEQAnet (California) follows projects through dated filings, e.g. Orland Power Solutions, Manteca (MND 2026-06-02, county approval 2026-07-16, air district 2026-09-09) and Couco Creek, Turlock (approval 2025-08-21). EPA LMOP (102 landfill RNG projects) and AgSTAR (73 farm digesters) give construction status without permit dates; CDFA lists California grants. Capacity is not published.
main_caveats: Approval is not construction: CEQA notices of determination show decisions (Manteca 2026-07-16 and 2026-09-09); no start-of-construction or operation document was found.
LMOP (September 2024) and AgSTAR (June 2024) status fields are stale: 8 planned LMOP rows and 49 of 73 AgSTAR construction rows have expected years already past.
LMOP 'Planned', AgSTAR 'Construction' and CDFA funding data are not permitting stages; their dates are anticipated starts or grant dates.
No project capacity is published in the records opened; LMOP and AgSTAR give landfill-gas or raw-biogas volumes, not RNG output.
Wisconsin WARP documents are behind page postbacks and were not read; Oregon and county portals outside California were not checked.
answer.confidence_reason: Two projects were followed to dated approval documents and counts come from downloaded files; coverage outside California and Wisconsin, and permit texts with capacity, were not checked.

attributes.note: CEQAnet gives address, parcel and some coordinates (California); LMOP gives landfill coordinates via a join; AgSTAR and CDFA give city and county.
attributes.gap_note: County and state permit records outside California and Wisconsin, and Oregon, were not checked.

attributes.note: No project RNG capacity found. LMOP gives landfill-gas input (19 of 102 rows); AgSTAR raw biogas cu ft/day (16 of 73); CEQA records give truck trips and buildings only.
attributes.gap_note: Full mitigated negative declarations, air-district evaluations and Wisconsin permit documents, which may state capacity, were not read.

attributes.note: CEQAnet names the applicant (Orland Power Solutions, Couco Creek Dairy Biogas); LMOP developer on 79 of 102 RNG rows; AgSTAR and CDFA name developer companies.
attributes.gap_note: Projects outside California and landfills in other states' permit portals were not matched to developers.

attributes.note: CEQAnet document types give stage (consultation, negative declaration, approval); Wisconsin WARP gives permit milestones. LMOP, AgSTAR, CDFA: construction or funding status only.
attributes.gap_note: No national stage field exists; only two California projects and one Wisconsin facility were followed to stage documents.

attributes.note: CEQAnet Received and Approved On dates and WARP milestone dates; LMOP anticipated start and CDFA grant dates are not stage dates.
attributes.gap_note: Dates exist only for records opened; there is no national list of stage dates.

sources.name: CEQAnet: California CEQA database of project records and filed documents
sources.publisher: California Governor's Office of Land Use and Climate Innovation (LCI), State Clearinghouse
sources.format: HTML record pages, per-document CSV export and PDF attachments
sources.summary: Dated CEQA documents with applicant and site: for example Orland Power Solutions (Manteca) MND 2026-06-02, county approval 2026-07-16, air-district approval 2026-09-09.
sources.coverage_note: California only; approval stages, no capacity; keyword search not scriptable.
caveats: Notice of determination = approved, not built.

problems: Free-text search is a Google Custom Search widget; the /Search 'q' parameter returned unrelated documents (18,765 for 2026).

example.example_request: curl -sL https://ceqanet.lci.ca.gov/2026060079/1 (and /2, /3) ; per-document CSV: curl -sL -o doc3.csv 'https://ceqanet.lci.ca.gov/Search?Sch=2026060079&DocumentId=3&OutputFormat=CSV' ; attachment link pattern /2026060079/3/Attachment/<id> is on each record page.
example.example_result: SCH 2026060079, Lead Agency San Joaquin County: document 1 MND received 6/2/2026; document 2 NOD received 7/22/2026, approved 7/16/2026 by the County Planning Commission; document 3 NOD received 9/11/2026, approved 9/9/2026 by the San Joaquin Valley APCD; applicant Orland Power Solutions, LLC; 8350 E Brady Road, Manteca; APN 257-220-04, -05; 37°43'44"N 121°11'52"W.

sources.name: LMOP under-construction or planned landfill gas energy projects (September 2024)
sources.publisher: U.S. EPA, Landfill Methane Outreach Program (LMOP)
sources.format: XLSX (sheets Summary, LMOP Database, Field Descriptions)
sources.summary: 102 landfill RNG projects not yet operating (26 under construction, 76 planned) with developer, delivery method and anticipated start; September 2024.
sources.coverage_note: Landfills only; LMOP status, not permit stage; coordinates via landfill file join.
caveats: Planned is not a permitting stage; 8 planned rows have start dates already past in 2024.

sources.name: AgSTAR Livestock Anaerobic Digester Database: rows with Status = Construction
sources.summary: 73 livestock digesters listed under construction (35 with pipeline gas), with developer and expected year; labelled June 2024.
sources.coverage_note: Farm digesters only; expected years often already past; no permit stage.
caveats: 49 of 73 expected years are 2024 or earlier.

sources.name: DDRDP Project-Level Data of Executed and Funded Grant Projects (updated 2026-10-15)
sources.publisher: California Department of Food and Agriculture (CDFA), Dairy Digester Research and Development Program
sources.summary: 142 funded California dairy-digester grants (16 below 100% disbursed, 13 of them RNG) with developer, city, county and grant dates; updated 2026-10-15.
sources.coverage_note: California grants only; funding stage, not permitting.
caveats: Grant dates are not permit dates.
Cancelled projects are mixed in the table.

sources.name: Wisconsin DNR Air Management Permit Tracking (WARP) facility pages
sources.publisher: Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources, Air Management Program
sources.format: HTML pages (ASP.NET) with permit tables and PDF documents behind page postbacks
sources.summary: Wisconsin DNR air-permit milestones per facility (application, public notice, decision), e.g. Chevron C-Dairy RNG LLC, Mondovi: construction permit 24-MIN-280 decided 2025-08-19.
sources.coverage_note: Wisconsin air permits only; three facility pages opened; documents not read.
caveats: Facility must be found first; documents sit behind postbacks.
Permit scope (new project vs expansion) not verified.

problems: Permit documents are served through ASP.NET postbacks; a scripted postback for a document returned HTML again.

if_unstructured.summary: Stage, date, applicant and site are in permit documents, not in a list: county use permits and CEQA filings, air-district notices and state air permits.

local_terms.meaning: California portal and the notice filed after a project is approved; open the SCH number's documents 1, 2, 3.

local_terms.term: Conditional Use Permit (CUP) / Use Permit Application
local_terms.meaning: County zoning permit for a digester or injection site; appears as the CEQAnet title.
Air-district permit key such as N-1261215 in San Joaquin Valley APCD records.
CEQA document type posted for state review before county approval.
EPA file of landfill-gas projects not yet operating.
CDFA Dairy Digester Research and Development Program; project-level grant list.

local_terms.term: WARP permit tracking / construction permit (MIN, BAP)
local_terms.meaning: Wisconsin DNR air permit pages with numbers such as 24-MIN-280.
Facility that off-loads trucked biogas into a utility pipeline, as at Couco Creek.

provenance.note: Minutes are researcher estimates. Counts describe documented passes, not publication approval. Missing history or effort is not reconstructed.
